chunks: The Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام said: “Whoever loves to depart from this world having been purified of sins, just as gold is purified with no impurity in it, and with no one seeking any claim against him due to a wrong, then let him say after the five salats the attribution of the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, twelve times, then spread out his hands and say:”
O Allah, I ask You by Your hidden, stored, pure, utterly pure, blessed Name, and I ask You by Your mighty Name and Your eternal authority, to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

O Giver of gifts, O Releaser of captives, O Freer of necks from the Fire, I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to free my neck from the Fire, and to bring me out of the world safe, and to admit me into Paradise sound, and to make my supplication—its beginning prosperity, its middle success, and its end rectitude.
“Indeed, You are the Knower of the unseen things.”

Then the Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام said: “This is from the hidden matters among what the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم taught me and commanded me to teach al-Hasan and al-Husayn عليهما السلام.”

key_terms.اسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُونِ الْمَخْزُونِ: Your hidden and guarded Name invoked in supplication
key_terms.الذُّنُوبِ: sins from which the supplicant seeks purification
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the final abode requested in the du'a
key_terms.عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ: the One possessing complete knowledge of all unseen realities
key_terms.فَكَّاكَ الرِّقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ: the One who frees people from the Fire

ai.seo_question: What supplication did أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام teach for forgiveness after the five daily salats?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a post-salat supplication for one who wishes to leave the world purified from sins and free of others’ claims. It emphasizes invoking Allah through His exalted Names, sending blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, seeking deliverance from the Fire, safe death, and entry into Paradise. The closing statement presents this supplication as a concealed teaching transmitted by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.949 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Whoever wishes to leave this world with their sins purified, like gold that is free of impurities, and without anyone having a claim against them, let them say at the end of the five daily prayers the praise of the Lord (azj) (Surah Ikhlas) twelve times, then raise their hands and say:
'O’ Allah (swt), I ask You by Your hidden, stored, pure, blessed, and great name, and by Your ancient sovereignty, to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

O’ Giver of gifts, O’ Reliever of captives, O’ Liberator of necks from the fire, I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to free my neck from the fire, to take me out of this world safely, to admit me into Paradise peacefully, and to make my supplication the beginning of success, its middle fruitful, and its end righteous, for You are the Knower of the unseen.'"

Then Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"This is from the hidden teachings that the Messenger of Allah (sw) taught me and instructed me to teach to Imam Hasan (as) and Imam Hussain (as)."
